info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API enables users to remove scheduled healthcare appointments from the system efficiently. This endpoint allows healthcare providers and administrators to manage their appointment scheduling dynamically by canceling appointments that are no longer needed. Typical consumers include healthcare staff who need to respond to patient requests for cancellations. Leveraging this API helps maintain accurate scheduling, improves resource allocation, and enhances patient management by ensuring that appointment slots are freed up promptly.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing appointment, ensuring that their schedule is updated accordingly. Upon successful cancellation, appropriate notifications may be sent to the relevant parties.

requestBody.description: A request to cancel a scheduled appointment. This operation requires the appointment ID to be specified in the request body to identify which appointment should be canceled.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: A request body that specifies the cancellation details for an appointment operation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Appointment Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation.

resultId.description: An identifier representing the result of the cancellation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: Response object for the appointment cancellation operation.
